protocol.tool: Existing BenchmarkDotNet comparison projects; all measured work validated during Setup.
protocol.settings: InProcessEmit; 8 warmups, 12 measurements, unroll 1, no outlier removal. CSV uses 32 invocations and XLSX uses 16.
protocol.order: CSV full A1/B1 followed by affected-reader and control B2/A2 repeats. XLSX runs all 12 lanes in each ABBA leg.
protocol.interpretation: Median of every retained per-operation result sample. Separate 25k CSV stream/line/partition and50k snapshot/typed/write workloads; span-only peer lanes are separate contracts from owned-string readers.
protocol.hostLimits: Normal priority, no affinity or quiet-host claim; M4 performance/efficiency cores and unrelated CI activity. Unchanged peer/writer movement is a control, not an implementation gain.
protocol.readBoundary: CSV text and UTF8inputs are prepared outside timing; stream lane opens prepared bytes. Every raw string field, typed row and writer output is validated by existing fixture.
protocol.validation: All parser validation, cancellation/error/factory ordering, public APIs and supported frameworks retained. Full XML/UTF8proof remains before delivery. No new production dependencies.

csv.validation: Existing Setup validated every participant before fingerprinting the actual benchmark input.
Existing Setup validated every participant before fingerprinting the actual benchmark input.

validation.nativeAot: CSV and Excel osx-arm64 native smokes pass, including Unicode/buffer rollover/partition reads and large escaped implicit XLSX raw/typed reads.
validation.review: One independent full pass and one targeted confirmation. The empty-run defect reproduced with two failures among six pre-fix cases. Both shared helpers retain pending empty fields; 96 focused CSV and 130 focused Excel tests pass. The text standard-tail sibling correction is source-confirmed; its generic continuation is a passing control.
validation.platformLimits: ARM64 net8/net10 and NativeAOT executed locally. Windows/x64 timing and Windows net472 runtime require their own execution evidence; this is not a portable 20 percent claim.

targets: CSV UTF-8 ReadCore and the legacy reusable row parser
profiling.limits: Sampled managed thread stacks guide the changes; unresolved unmanaged and wait time is excluded from managed leaf summaries and is not treated as elapsed-time attribution.
